The opportunity

A strategic hosting partnership with the Philippine Open that accelerates PSC's sports tourism, youth development and national infrastructure ambitions.

  • Sports tourism
  • A national open
  • Grassroots and youth development
  • Premium hospitality
  • Experiences money can't buy

Two ways to partner

PSC can come in as Presenting Partner or as Founding Partner of The BingoPlus Philippine Open. Both run for three years, with a 5% compounded escalator, in the Philippines.

Presenting Partner

Presenting Partner of The BingoPlus Philippine Open

US$2,400,000per year · 3 years · 5% compounded escalator

The premium partner position at any event, with a full complement of premium assets and benefits. That includes prominent, camera-visible on-course branding and exclusive VIP client hospitality and guest experiences.

Premium assets

What sits behind the partnership, from global media reach to time with LIV Golf's players.

Golf development and community impact

As part of the partnership with PSC, LIV Golf proposes a direct investment into golf and community development initiatives across the Philippines. LIV Golf can also provide strategic support and specialist expertise to help PSC build sustainable, long-term impact programmes.

Access to golf
Grassroots participation and junior golf pathways
Employment and skills
Apprenticeship, qualification and workforce development programmes
Community and education
Youth engagement and education-focused community initiatives
Development hubs
Potential hub model centred around Intramuros Golf Club and other participating facilities
